meta.description: Realistic foreman field update samples for testing NL-to-schedule matching on a mid-stage hyperscale data center build.

categories.easy: Area and trade mentioned clearly. Tests baseline matching.
categories.fuzzy: Slang, nicknames, abbreviations. No exact schedule terms. Tests alias resolution.
categories.ambiguous: Could map to 2+ activities. Tests scoring disambiguation.
categories.multi: One message covers two activities. Tests splitting and dual-match.
categories.pct_variation: Vague or non-numeric completion language. Tests extractPercentage.
categories.no_match: Work not in schedule, idle reports, or too vague to map.

messages.text: Hall A electrical conduit rough-in is about 60 percent complete.
messages.notes: Straightforward. All key tokens present.

messages.text: Chilled water piping in MER-1 is done for today, we got about 40 feet installed, sitting at 40 percent overall.
messages.notes: Linear footage metric alongside percentage. Common field pattern.

messages.text: Sprinkler rough-in in Hall B is 75 percent, should finish tomorrow.
messages.notes: Clean signal with timeline estimate.

messages.text: Cable tray in Hall A is fully installed, 100 percent.
messages.notes: Complete activity. Tests approved-state transition.

messages.text: Wire pull in the switchgear room is at 50 percent, got two crews on it.
messages.notes: Uses 'switchgear room' not 'ESR'. Common alias.

messages.text: Ductwork in MER-2 is 80 percent, just finishing the last runs.
messages.notes: Clean signal.

messages.text: Generator yard electrical conduit is 30 percent, broke ground today.
messages.notes: New start. Tests low-percentage handling.

messages.text: Hall B wire pull started this morning, about 10 percent in.
messages.notes: Early-stage activity.

messages.text: Fire suppression rough-in in the ESR is 90 percent complete.
messages.notes: Uses 'ESR' as abbreviation.

messages.text: Roof mechanical equipment pads are poured and cured, 100 percent done.
messages.notes: Complete. Mentions concrete action for a mechanical activity.

messages.text: Hall A plumbing rough-in is about halfway, 50 percent.
messages.notes: Both verbal and numeric percentage present.

messages.text: BAS sensor rough-in in Hall B is 65 percent, moving through the rows.
messages.notes: BAS spelled out.

messages.text: Steel mezzanine framing in MER-1 is 85 percent done.
messages.notes: Clean signal.

messages.text: Low voltage cable tray in Hall B complete, 100 percent.
messages.notes: Complete activity.

messages.text: Chilled water insulation in MER-2 is 40 percent, crews moving east to west.
messages.notes: Directional detail included.

messages.text: Hall A lighting rough-in is 70 percent, finishing the east rows today.
messages.notes: Sub-area directional detail.

messages.text: Generator yard grounding is done, 100 percent.
messages.notes: Complete.

messages.text: Fire sprinkler mains in Hall B are in, about 80 percent on the overall system.
messages.notes: Distinguishes mains from drops.

messages.text: ESR grounding grid is 55 percent complete.
messages.notes: Uses ESR abbreviation.

messages.text: Hall A overhead cable tray installation is at 45 percent, working north to south.
messages.notes: Directional progress detail.

messages.text: Pipe bending on the east side is almost done, just a few more sticks.
messages.notes: 'Pipe bending' = conduit work. 'East side' = Hall A. 'Sticks' = conduit lengths.

messages.text: Pulling wire in the gear room, should be wrapped up by end of day.
messages.notes: 'Gear room' = ESR. 'Pulling wire' = wire pull.

messages.text: CHW loop on the north mechanical is about three quarters in.
messages.notes: 'CHW loop' = chilled water piping. 'North mechanical' = MER-1.

messages.text: Running tray in the B hall, making good progress.
messages.notes: 'Running tray' = cable tray install. No percentage.

messages.text: Iron work on the south MER mezzanine is coming along, maybe 60 percent.
messages.notes: 'Iron work' = steel framing. 'South MER' = MER-2.

messages.text: We're in the duct work up top, got most of the main runs done.
messages.notes: 'Up top' = Roof. 'Main runs' = primary duct trunks.

messages.text: Controls guys are in hall one knocking out sensors, pretty far along.
messages.notes: 'Hall one' = Hall A. 'Sensors' = BAS sensor rough-in. No numeric percentage.

messages.text: Sprinkler drops in the west side are going up, probably halfway.
messages.notes: 'West side' = Hall B. 'Drops' = sprinkler head drops. Verbal pct only.

messages.text: Plumbing team is finishing the drain work on the A side.
messages.notes: 'A side' = Hall A. 'Drain work' = drain rough-in.

messages.text: Gen yard pipe is about a third done, had a late start this morning.
messages.notes: 'Gen yard' = Generator Yard. 'Pipe' = conduit. Fractional pct.

messages.text: Switchgear install in the ESR is almost buttoned up.
messages.notes: 'Buttoned up' = near complete. No numeric percentage.

messages.text: Low volt crew is pulling fiber in hall two, maybe 40 percent.
messages.notes: 'Hall two' = Hall B. 'Low volt' = LV trade. 'Pulling fiber' = fiber backbone.

messages.text: MEP rough-in on the south mechanical side is moving, chilled water mostly done.
messages.notes: 'MEP' umbrella term. 'South mechanical' = MER-2. Specifies chilled water.

messages.text: We finished the clean agent system in the gear room.
messages.notes: 'Clean agent' = FM200/suppression system. 'Gear room' = ESR.

messages.text: Welding up the equipment platforms in the north MER, about halfway.
messages.notes: 'North MER' = MER-1. 'Equipment platforms' = structural steel platforms.

messages.text: Home runs to the panels in hall A are 90 percent pulled.
messages.notes: 'Home runs' = feeder wire pulls back to panels. Trade-specific jargon.

messages.text: Ductwork in the B side mechanical room is tight quarters, moving slow, maybe 30 percent.
messages.notes: 'B side mechanical room' = MER-2. Notes field condition.

messages.text: BAS wiring in the west hall is in progress, sensors going in now.
messages.notes: 'West hall' = Hall B.

messages.text: Overhead steel in hall A is done, tray supports are all hung.
messages.notes: Compound update — overhead steel + tray support steel.

messages.text: Fire side is finishing mains in hall one, drops start tomorrow.
messages.notes: 'Hall one' = Hall A. Forward-looking note about drops.

messages.text: MEP work on the east side is about halfway done.
messages.notes: 'MEP' = mechanical, electrical, or plumbing. 'East side' = Hall A. Trade is unclear — matcher must use foreman ID to disambiguate.

messages.text: Level 2 work is moving, crews making progress.
messages.notes: No trade signal. 'Level 2' not in standard area list. Matcher should return low confidence.

messages.text: We're about 60 percent on the rough-in work in hall B.
messages.notes: Area clear, trade deducible from foreman ID, but 'rough-in' matches electrical conduit, plumbing, and fire protection. Scorer must weight foreman ID.

messages.text: North side is coming along, got a lot done today.
messages.notes: 'North side' could be MER-1 or Hall A north rows. No activity signal. Foreman ID narrows to steel.

messages.text: Electrical work in the MER is about 70 percent.
messages.notes: 'The MER' — doesn't specify MER-1 or MER-2. Matcher should flag ambiguity.

messages.text: Piping is 80 percent in the mechanical room.
messages.notes: 'Piping' could be mechanical CHW or plumbing. 'Mechanical room' doesn't specify MER-1 or MER-2.

messages.text: Hall A is making progress across the board.
messages.notes: Area clear, everything else vague. No activity, no trade, no percentage.

messages.text: We're almost done with the rough-in.
messages.notes: No area, no trade, no foreman context. Matcher cannot resolve.

messages.text: Cable work in the east hall is moving, about halfway.
messages.notes: 'Cable work' = low voltage cable tray OR electrical wire pull. Foreman ID resolves to LV.

messages.text: The mechanical team finished their work in the yard.
messages.notes: Generator Yard mechanical activity unclear. Complete status but no specific activity named.

messages.text: Conduit in hall A is done and we moved over to hall B, just started there.
messages.notes: Two activities: Hall A conduit = 100%, Hall B conduit = ~5%. Matcher must split.

messages.text: Finished the CHW piping in MER-1 and started on MER-2 this afternoon, about 20 percent on MER-2.
messages.notes: Two activities: MER-1 = 100%, MER-2 = 20%.

messages.text: Wire pull in the ESR is done, 100 percent. Hall B wire pull is at 30 percent.
messages.notes: Two explicit activity updates in one message. Clear area and pct for each.

messages.text: Duct work in hall A and hall B both wrapped up today, 100 percent on both.
messages.notes: Same activity, two areas, same completion. Matcher should update both.

messages.text: Cable tray in A hall is complete, moved the crew to start fiber backbone, just getting set up.
messages.notes: Two different activities in Hall A: tray = 100%, fiber = ~5%.

messages.text: Hall B conduit rough-in is basically done, just cleaning up.
messages.notes: 'Basically done, just cleaning up' ≈ 95%.

messages.text: Just broke ground on the roof mechanical this morning.
messages.notes: 'Just broke ground' ≈ 5%.

messages.text: MER-2 chilled water piping is a little past halfway.
messages.notes: 'A little past halfway' ≈ 55%.

messages.text: Almost wrapped up the fire suppression in Hall A, one more day.
messages.notes: 'Almost wrapped up, one more day' ≈ 90%.

messages.text: Sprinkler mains in hall B — we're in the early stages.
messages.notes: 'Early stages' ≈ 15%.

messages.text: ESR wire pull is three quarters done.
messages.notes: Fractional language — three quarters.

messages.text: Generator yard conduit is two thirds complete.
messages.notes: Fractional language — two thirds.

messages.text: Completely finished the cable tray in the B hall.
messages.notes: 'Completely finished' = 100%.

messages.text: BAS rough-in in Hall A, we haven't touched it yet.
messages.notes: 'Haven't touched it' = 0%. Tests zero-percent detection.

messages.text: Hall A ductwork, we're about four fifths done.
messages.notes: Fractional language — four fifths.

messages.text: Had a concrete pour scheduled today but the truck never showed, we're idle.
messages.notes: Activity not in schedule. Idle report. Matcher should return no match.

messages.text: Waiting on equipment delivery for the generator install, nothing to report.
messages.notes: Blocked by delivery. Area known but no matchable activity — no progress to log.

messages.text: Safety walk took all morning, no work done today.
messages.notes: Operational message, not a progress update. Matcher should return no match.

messages.text: Finished the drywall in the break room, all done.
messages.notes: Trade and area not in schedule. Out-of-scope work being reported.

messages.text: Material shortage on conduit, hall A crew is standing by.
messages.notes: Blocked status, not a progress update. No percentage, no activity completion signal.
